title: Senior Backend Developer (Mobile APIs)
text:
Demo Co. Hazel is an agency building education apps. We are looking for a senior-level Backend Developer (Mobile APIs) to join our mobile team. Work is two office days a week in Northhaven.

Our stack: python, csharp. You will ship features end to end, improve app performance and stability and review code with the team.

A small, senior team. You will mentor less experienced colleagues.

The role includes a 24/7 on-call rotation.
